SASBDB entry SASDV94  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDV94/)

Publication: Molecular virulence mechanism of phospholipase C from Pseudomonas aeruginosa
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/procel/pwag062

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDV94/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
